# AwsAuth, misconfigured

Each of these is a configuration error, which shows in the block's place.

<AwsAuth id="two_blocks" detectCredentials={[{ block: "keys" }, { block: "other_keys" }]} />

<AwsAuth id="no_detection" detectCredentials={true} />

`misspelled` names `asume_role`, and the block is `assume_role`.

<AwsAuth id="misspelled" detectCredentials={[{ block: "asume_role" }]} />

`off` turns detection off, so it waits for the person to sign in.

<AwsAuth id="off" detectCredentials={false} defaultTab="sso" ssoStartUrl="https://example.awsapps.com/start" />

<Command id="keys" command="true" />

<Command id="other_keys" command="true" />

<Command id="assume_role" command="true" />
